name: Oriana Power Ltd
tagline: Fast-growing solar EPC + RESCO player now with a large arm's-length SECI green-ammonia offtake - but a SEBI warning letter, heavy promoter-entity related-party sales and trusted-user balance-sheet distrust keep it HIGH CAUTION
business_overview: Solar EPC and RESCO (build-own-operate) developer on the SME board, diversifying into BESS, green hydrogen/ammonia, CBG and e-fuel; ~1/3 of historic revenue was sales to promoter-group entities.
fundamentals_table: Small-cap, SME board; recently near 52-week low
SECI green ammonia PA: 60,000 TPA at Rs 52.25/kg, ~Rs 3,135 Cr over 10 years, Sagar (MP); Madhya Bharat Agro end off-taker
March 2025 SEBI warning letter (ICDR disclosure); related-party revenue concentration
fundamentals_narrative: Reported metrics (ROCE ~32%, ~159% growth off a small base) arithmetically fit a 10x profile. The SECI green-ammonia offtake, formalised 30 Mar 2026, materialises the Aug-2025 SIGHT LoA and adds the first large contracted, genuinely arm's-length (SECI-backed) revenue stream (~Rs 300 Cr/yr average once the plant is built). It does not resolve the March-2025 SEBI warning letter, the historic ~1/3 related-party revenue, the scripted/over-moderated concalls, or the multi-vertical capex-intensive diversification that trusted users call unproven.
sentiment_summary: No new forum activity since the prior read (thread stable, highest #78). Prior sentiment stands: several elevated-tier users (hnk_so, vikas_sinha, Shail1234) explicitly distrust the balance sheet / governance and will not invest.
community_signal: Prior trusted signal carried forward: Shail1234 (2026-06-26) - poor concall, no main-board-migration update, 'green hydrogen, CBG, e-fuel, electrolyzer - so far it's nothing'.
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: TrueRE Oriana Power - SECI Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement formalised 30 Mar 2026, 60,000 TPA at Rs 52.25/kg, ~Rs 3,135 Cr / 10 years, project at Sagar (MP), end off-taker Madhya Bharat Agro; materialises the Aug-2025 LoA under SIGHT.
SEBI warning letter (March 2025, ICDR disclosure) and related-party revenue concentration remain unresolved.
bull_case: Reported ROCE ~32% and ~159% growth off a small base
SECI green-ammonia offtake gives first large, contracted, arm's-length revenue visibility (10-year)
Optionality across BESS, green hydrogen/ammonia, CBG
bear_case: March 2025 SEBI warning letter - an active regulatory flag
~1/3 of historic revenue from promoter-group entities - model integrity unverifiable from outside
Multiple elevated-tier users explicitly distrust the balance sheet / governance; concalls scripted and over-moderated
Green-ammonia plant is years out, debt- and capex-intensive; execution entirely unproven
Still SME-board with the disclosure/liquidity limits that implies
verdict_headline: Re-verification: the SECI green-ammonia offtake is a real, large, arm's-length catalyst, but it does not clear the SEBI / related-party / governance overhang - HIGH CAUTION and Low conviction stand
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The SECI Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement is verified exactly as described and is genuinely positive - it adds the first large contracted non-promoter revenue stream and 10-year visibility.

But it is years from revenue and does nothing about the March-2025 SEBI warning letter, the historic ~1/3 related-party revenue, or the explicit balance-sheet distrust from several elevated-tier users - so the HIGH CAUTION tier and Low conviction are unchanged.

thesis_fit stays 10x-in-2-3-years (reported numbers support the headline math); no 30-day revisit (HIGH CAUTION + Low). Re-check if the SEBI matter closes cleanly, related-party revenue share falls materially, the company migrates to the main board, and green-ammonia/BESS revenue actually appears.
red_flag_reason: March 2025 SEBI warning letter (ICDR disclosure) still unresolved; ~1/3 of historic revenue from promoter-group entities; multiple elevated-tier users explicitly distrust the balance sheet.

value_chain.theme: renewables build-out: solar EPC/RESCO + BESS + green hydrogen/ammonia
value_chain.position: solar EPC and RESCO developer moving into green ammonia (SIGHT/SECI) and BESS
value_chain.note: Sector is adding capacity aggressively; Oriana's edge is the SECI green-ammonia LoA-to-PA conversion, but governance and related-party concerns dominate the capital-cycle read here.

trusted_signals.note: Poor concall - over-moderated, no direct investor questions, no main-board-migration or Actis per-MW-profit update; diversification 'so far it's nothing'.
